scope: Individuals whose personal data is handled by private-sector organisations in Brunei
applies_to: Private-sector organisations (and private processors acting for government agencies); government agencies excluded
key_requirements: Purpose limitation and consent with withdrawal; access, correction and accuracy; security arrangements, retention limits, overseas transfer protections; appoint at least one DPO
enforcement_authority: Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam (AITI)
penalties_range: Administrative penalty up to 10% of annual Brunei turnover (if turnover exceeds BND 10M) or BND 1M otherwise (unconfirmed)
notes: Most provisions (Parts 3-9) commenced 2026-01-01 per commencement notification; penalty details conflict between secondary sources
